title: Lazar's Bendix Field Engineering badge as an intelligence cover
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Lazar's Bendix Field Engineering badge as an intelligence cover, about 1980s at Nevada test site and Area 51, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We knew what that meant. And then when I saw Lazar's ID briefly in one book, there was a photo. There was a copy of it and I saw it and I said, "Holy [ __ ] Lazar worked for Bendix Field Engineering. That was his cover then.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about the occult and secret history, says that when he saw a copy of Bob Lazar's work ID in a book, he recognised it right away. Lazar is a man who says he worked on unusual craft at a secret site near Area 51, a hidden military base in the Nevada desert, in the 1980s. Levenda says the badge showed Lazar worked for a company called Bendix Field Engineering, which he and others took as a sign of an intelligence cover job, and if so it would suggest Lazar really was placed inside secret government work.
